The {wiki:Rift Warrior Outfits|Rift Warrior Outfits} are earned by completing the {wiki:Ferumbras' Ascension Quest}. The two addons are bought from {npc:Cledwyn}, each for 100 {item:Silver Token|Silver Tokens}, collected in the dungeons of {wiki:The Ruthless Seven Minions|The Ruthless Seven Minions}. At the end you also earn the achievement **Rift Warrior**.
No minimum level, but the **recommended level is 250+** (the dungeons have {creature:Hellflayer|Hellflayers}, {creature:Vexclaw|Vexclaws} and the bosses of the Ruthless Seven Minions).
Addons: 100 {item:Silver Token|Silver Tokens} for each addon (200 in total).
to go to the Adventurers' Guild from a temple
{npc:Cledwyn} also exchanges Silver Tokens for body armours; if you ask for {key:silver}, he shows all the options. For the addons say {key:addons}.
The addons can be bought in any order: choose {key:first} or {key:second}.
Complete the {wiki:Ferumbras' Ascension Quest}. When you finish it you receive the base {wiki:Rift Warrior Outfits|Rift Warrior Outfit}.
Getting to the Ruthless Seven Minions dungeons

The dungeons are behind the portal of {npc:Mazarius}, in **Darashia** (**northeast** part of the city). You only get access after handing him the 30 {item:Demonic Essence|Demonic Essences} at the start of the {wiki:Ferumbras' Ascension Quest} (level 150+ to talk to him). Step into the portal **north** of Mazarius, in his room: you arrive in a protection zone. Follow the caves (with {creature:Vexclaw|Vexclaws}, {creature:Hellflayer|Hellflayers}, {creature:Grimeleech|Grimeleeches} and {creature:Demon|Demons}) to the end, go down the stairs and you reach the big room with the path to the portals of each of the seven minions.
Path from the entrance to the minions' portal room
Hunting in the Ruthless Seven Minions dungeons
Collect {item:Silver Token|Silver Tokens} in the {wiki:The Ruthless Seven Minions|The Ruthless Seven Minions} dungeons. You need **100 per addon** (200 for both).
In these dungeons you find {creature:Hellflayer|Hellflayers}, {creature:Vexclaw|Vexclaws} and the seven newest members of the Ruthless Seven Minions. Go well prepared and in a team.

After killing a boss, the exit teleport in the room takes you back to the safe room before the entrance, so you don't need to save supplies for the way back. From there, go back the same way to Mazarius's room in Darashia.
Don't stay in the boss room after killing it: if time runs out you are teleported out.

Go to the temple of any city and use an {item:Adventurer's Stone} to be taken to the {wiki:Adventurers' Guild}. If you don't have one, ask a temple NPC for another: {key:hi}, {key:adventurer's stone}, {key:yes}. {npc:Cledwyn} is near the Reward Chest.
With 100 Silver Tokens in your backpack, talk to {npc:Cledwyn}: {key:hi}, {key:silver}, {key:addons} and {key:first}.

To leave, step on the Guild's teleport: it takes you back to the city you came from. If you prefer to appear in another city, {npc:Charos} can change the teleport's destination ({key:service}).
